{{Quote|My name's Vonddado Briimyo. I fix starships. Skavak kidnapped me. One minute, we were drinking Corellian whiskey at the cantina. The next, I was his prisoner!|Vonddado Briimyo|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vonddado Briimyo''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Technician/Legends|Mechanic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Briimyo worked with the gangster [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] and was forced to repair the ship, which belonged to the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Voidhound|Ace]]. He encountered Ace, who was here to find Skavak and retrieve the stolen Arkanian Hyperdrive. Briimyo was able to tell Ace where the Skavak was, and begged the smuggler to let him go. When Ace allowed to leave, Briimyo thanked the smuggler and fled.
{{Endgame}}
